skins.name: Adventure Time (BMO Terminal)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Mathematical! BMO handheld aesthetic featuring seafoam chassis, thick cartoon outlines, D-pad accents, and Finn & Jake roaming characters.

skins.name: Adventure Time (Candy Kingdom Control Panel)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: A pastel candy-box control panel: wavy ink borders, wrapped sweets along the frame, a bubbly marquee, an eight-core candy-brain matrix, a little console robot on the GPU card and a waving kid under a smiling sun.

skins.name: Cyberpunk 2077 (Arasaka Kiroshi HUD)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: High-contrast Night City cyberware optical telemetry. Features chamfered carbon bezels, vibrant Cyber Yellow accents, glitch scanlines, and Silverhand silhouettes.

skins.name: Dexter's Laboratory (Secret Mainframe)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Mid-century retro-future scientific mainframe. Features purple-glove accents, radioactive neon green indicators, industrial hazard trim, and Dexter vs. Dee Dee roaming animations.

skins.name: Dexter's Lab (System Console)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: A cartoon lab supercomputer: bubbling vacuum tubes, a klaxon that wails at critical load, switch-covered side pillars, wedge dials, an oscilloscope and a thermometer on the weather screen, all in thick ink outlines.

skins.name: Dexter's Lab (Secret Lab HUD)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: A 90s cartoon lab terminal: heavy ink outlines, a top-left chamfer, angled cyan header tabs, neon chemical capsules and the lab bot over a suburb with a secret bunker beneath it.

skins.name: The Hitchhiker's Guide (Sub-Etha)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: The Guide's own look: 1981 phosphor CRT after dark, the 2005 movie's cream pages by day. Built into both apps.

skins.name: macOS Glass (Golden Gate)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Frosted acrylic squircles with traffic lights on every card, smooth International Orange capsules, and the bridge tower at Marin dusk or Presidio daylight.

skins.name: macOS Golden Gate (System Hub)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Smoked frosted glass over Marin Headlands dusk, or Presidio daylight: International Orange and golden-hour amber, capsule meters, soft graphs and a suspension bridge on the horizon.

skins.name: macOS Liquid Glass
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Liquid Glass: translucent rounded panes with a 1px specular rim, soft deep elevation, capsule pills and gauges, in graphite dark and frosted light.

skins.name: Material You (M3 Expressive)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Material 3 Expressive: tonal surface containers, 24px rounded cards, stadium pills and capsule gauges on soft elevation, in Monet lavender light and dark.

skins.name: Mirror's Edge (Runner Vision)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Clinical, high-contrast City of Glass aesthetic. Features pristine matte white surfaces, deep obsidian lines, intense Runner Vision Red accents, and Faith parkour silhouettes.

skins.name: Mirror's Edge Catalyst (OS 2.0)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: A runner's tactical HUD over the City of Glass: 45° chamfered cards in a hairline Runner Red, an isometric CPU socket and GPU die, a wireframe skyline at dusk or high noon.

skins.name: Mirror's Edge (Runner Vision)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Runner Vision in two shifts: Infiltration at night (black glass, red edges) and the City of Glass by day (white and steel). Numbered red flag tabs, 45° cut corners and discrete red segment meters.

skins.name: VT-Terminal (1970s/1980s CRT)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: A DEC VT100 / IBM 3270 glass teletype: P1 green phosphor in dark mode, P3 amber in light, raster scanlines, discrete block gauges, a phosphor glow and wireframe Arthur and Marvin on the ground line.

skins.name: Rick and Morty (Dimension C-137)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: A garage-built interdimensional dashboard: riveted scrap plating dripping green ooze, twin spinning portals, an eight-trace core oscilloscope, a slime-filled VRAM tube and comic speech bubbles.

skins.name: Windows Vista (Aero Glass)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Aero Glass: icy teal-tinted translucent panes with soft depth, rounded corners and segmented green meters, in midnight and daylight glass.

skins.name: Windows Vista (Aero Glass)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Frutiger Aero: translucent teal glass with a curved specular sheen, glossy green and icy-blue meters, a glass pearl and Westminster at aurora dusk or meadow daylight.

skins.name: Windows Vista (Sidebar Gadgets)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Sidebar gadgets on Aero glass: a curved gloss over each panel, chrome-rimmed analog dials with glowing needles, an oscilloscope CPU graph and glassy green LED memory bars.

skins.name: Windows XP (Luna)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Luna: royal blue desktop, beige Explorer panels with a hard drop shadow, a green Start pushbutton and segmented green LED meters; Royale Noir after dark.
